SPECULATIVE OPTIONS:
  --draft_model: draft hf model path to the model file.

  --mtp_draft_vocab_path: MUSA only. File listing one token id per line. The MTP draft LMHead scores only these tokens with a 128x128 block-FP8 copy of their target LMHead rows and gives every other token a -inf logit. Target verification keeps the full LMHead; only the draft proposals and their acceptance rate change.
  --enable_mtp_target_fp8_lm_head: MUSA only. Run the MTP target LMHead on a 128x128 block-FP8 copy of its weight, halving the bytes read per verify, and recompute the best logits of every token with the original weight. Greedy outputs match the original LMHead except near exact ties; other logits are approximate.
  --enable_mtp_packed_verify_attention: MUSA only. MTP target verification runs one causal FA3 decode call per sequence over all of its verify tokens instead of expanding every verify token into its own decode row, so each KV page is read once per sequence.
  --enable_atb_spec_kernel: Whether to use ATB speculative kernel.

EXECUTION OPTIONS:
  --enable_graph: Whether to enable graph execution for decode phase. When enabled, the engine uses graph mode (CUDA Graph for GPU, ACL Graph for NPU, MLU Graph, or DCU Graph) to optimize decode performance by reducing kernel launch overhead and device idle time.
  --disable_graph_warmup: Whether to skip synthetic graph warmup during engine startup. When enabled, graphs are captured lazily by real requests.
  --enable_graph_double_buffer: Whether to enable double-buffered ACL graph persistent params and graph instances for NPU schedule-overlap decode.
  --enable_graph_mode_decode_no_padding: Whether to enable graph execution for decode phase without padding. If true, graph will be captured with every actual num tokens, as stride is 1.
  --enable_prefill_piecewise_graph: Whether to enable piecewise graph execution for prefill phase when graph mode is enabled. When enabled, attention operations use eager mode while other operations are captured in device graphs.
  --enable_graph_vmm_pool: Whether to enable VMM-backed graph memory pool for multi-shape graph memory reuse.
  --max_tokens_for_graph_mode: Maximum number of tokens for graph execution. If 0, no limit is applied.
  --acl_graph_decode_batch_size_limit: Decode batch size threshold for ACL graph on NPU. When actual decode batch_size > this value, ACL graph decode falls back to eager mode to avoid OOM.
  --enable_shm: Whether to enable shared memory for executing model.
  --use_contiguous_input_buffer: Whether to use contiguous device input buffer for executing model.
  --input_shm_size: Input shared memory size, default is 1GB.
  --output_shm_size: Output shared memory size, default is 128MB.
  --forward_execution_timeout_ms: Deadline in milliseconds for a dispatched worker execution. Must be positive; idle workers are not timed out.
  --random_seed: Random seed for random number generator.
  --python_graph_backend: Graph backend for the Python model executor. Defaults to aclgraph on NPU when --enable_graph is enabled. Values: off (eager), cudagraphs (CUDA decode graph with eager prefill), aclgraph (NPU decode graph with eager prefill), or any torch.compile backend name.
  --enable_fia_decode: Enable FIA for Qwen3.5 decode attention. Applies to both target and MTP draft models. Prefill attention is unaffected.
  --enable_graph_aux_hidden_states: Let the deepseek_v41 target publish its transiently-incompatible aux capture through a persistent graph buffer instead of staying eager. The transient aux capture returns a (hidden, aux) tuple; the deepseek_v41 graph path (CSA2 backend + fused ops) cannot replay that tuple, so with this flag off that one target is pinned to eager. Every other aux-capture target replays the transient tuple through the graph fine (fixed-address pool allocation since #240) and is never affected by this flag. When enabled the v41 capture buffer becomes persistent (fixed address, graph-capturable) and the executor re-attaches the aux slice to the graph output (gate chain: py_causal_lm -> deepseek_v41.py AuxHiddenCapture -> decode_acl_graph -> executor aux publish).
  --musa_prefill_graph_token_stride: Token bucket stride for single-sequence MUSA Prefill graphs. Decode buckets and exact multi-sequence GDN layouts are unchanged.
  --musa_prefill_graph_max_entries: Maximum retained Prefill graph keys per MUSA executor. Existing keys replay at the limit; unseen keys execute eager before any capture or VMM address-space allocation.
  --musa_prefill_warmup_reserve_mb: Additional MiB excluded from the KV budget for MUSA piecewise Prefill preparation peaks and graph overhead. Applies once to the shared target/draft memory estimate, in addition to the max_memory_utilization headroom.

KERNEL OPTIONS:
  --enable_musa_fp8_skinny_gemm: Run block-scaled FP8 linears with at most 8 input rows and at least 65536 output columns (LM heads) on the MP31 skinny FP8 GEMM; other shapes keep the muDNN GEMM.
